chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abu Uthman, who raised it to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him),
He said: 'Indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, removed the leprosy from the Jews by their eating the chard and their pulling out the roots.'
ai.seo_question: What is the reason given for Allah removing leprosy from the Jews?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) links the removal of leprosy from the Jews to their consumption of chard (*silq*) and uprooting of plants, reflecting the Shia exegetical tradition of viewing dietary habits as having direct spiritual and physical consequences. This specific detail highlights the concept of *'illah* (cause) in divine retribution, where a particular communal practice led to a specific purification or affliction, underscoring the holistic connection between body, diet, and soul in Islamic theology.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Abu Usman, 
(It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>
having said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Raised the leprosy from the Jews by their eating the Chard, and their gouging out the veils’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘ Abd Allah from al-Hassan ibn Ali from abu ‘Uthman in a marfu ‘ manner who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, removed leprosy from Jews because of their eating beets and their cutting the veins.’”
